quest-to-github.description: Create a Jekyll resource locally from a Quest JSON file. Handles conversion only — deployment and archiving are separate commands.

jekyll-deploy.description: Deploy a Jekyll site to GitHub Pages. Creates the remote repository, enables Pages, and pushes the initial commit. Does not archive — that is a separate command.

quest-archive.description: Validate and archive a quest after review. Moves the fiche to Terminated in the registry, then archives the files (JSON + local repo).
